capabilities.name: Web UI

historical_reconciliation.name: Meaning coherence
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Define meaning-preservation labels and controlled paraphrases; content-length scores cannot establish coherence.

historical_reconciliation.name: Context integrity
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Use controlled context changes and relevant/irrelevant information contrasts.

historical_reconciliation.name: Narrative consistency
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Define entity/event consistency, temporal checks and annotation rules.

historical_reconciliation.name: Reflexivity / reflection
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Measure observable error detection and correction; self-description of thought is not a ground-truth mental process.

historical_reconciliation.name: Responsibility alignment
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Generic responsibility and governance records exist; historical normative task validity is unestablished.

historical_reconciliation.name: Expectation logic
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Consequence telemetry is a narrow observable descendant, not validation of forecast reasoning.

historical_reconciliation.name: Semantic stability
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Repeated/paraphrased prompts need equivalence checks and prespecified scoring.

historical_reconciliation.name: Multi-layer reasoning
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Separate task difficulty and observable correctness from claims about internal reasoning layers.

historical_reconciliation.name: Contradiction/conflict handling
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Conflict/contradiction records and stress vectors exist; no validated semantic conflict battery.

historical_reconciliation.name: Long-form coherence
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Text coherence is distinct from milestone completion over long trajectories.

historical_reconciliation.name: Singularity stress
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Retain testable transitions only; retire singularity-based interpretation from prospective public scoring.

historical_reconciliation.name: QGI indicators
historical_reconciliation.rationale: No operational QGI criterion; do not prioritize a general-intelligence indicator over concrete tasks.

historical_reconciliation.name: Decision transparency
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Evaluate usefulness and consistency of explanations without assuming privileged access to internal reasoning.

historical_reconciliation.name: Model safety behavior
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Generic boundary and recovery heuristics provide a foundation; policy-specific tasks and empirical false-positive studies remain.

historical_reconciliation.name: Energy efficiency
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Documentation, latency and output length do not measure joules; require instrumented hardware and accounting boundaries.

historical_reconciliation.name: Documentation transparency
historical_reconciliation.rationale: A source-cited metadata audit is feasible but must be separate from model performance.

historical_reconciliation.name: Architectural weakness mapping
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Public documentation can support hypotheses, not unobserved model internals or causal diagnosis.

historical_reconciliation.name: Semantic Maturity Framework
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Historical umbrella covers 12/extended families; current smf constant producer and conflicting expansions are not continuity.

historical_reconciliation.name: Human Intelligence Benchmark
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Historical question program requires research ethics, sampling, accessibility and validation before any human-intelligence interpretation.

historical_reconciliation.name: Human-AI Comparative Semantic Benchmark Standard
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Historical human-AI comparison must have separate identity from current hacs agent-resilience producer.

historical_reconciliation.name: Cognitive Bias Failure
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Operationalize bias behavior using controlled items and error criteria; historical variants require version reconciliation.

historical_reconciliation.name: Knowledge illusion / misinformation concepts
historical_reconciliation.rationale: Distinguish factual accuracy, confidence calibration and abstention; introspective explanations cannot establish metacognitive ability.

roadmap.objective: Create one truthful benchmark identity/lifecycle and minimum run-evidence contract.
roadmap.deliverables: Registry schema and migrations; synthetic/partial labels; versioned tasks/rubrics; evidence completeness and retirement rules
roadmap.exit_criteria: Every current family has an owner, immutable ID/version, explicit maturity, runner/evaluator linkage or declared absence; missing scores/provenance cannot silently mean success.

roadmap.objective: Reconcile metrics and uncertainty before adding more benchmark claims.
roadmap.deliverables: Metric registry, construct/scale/missingness specs, justified estimator choice, honest reports
roadmap.exit_criteria: Each emitted metric has a computable definition and limitations; fixed scores/intervals are explicitly synthetic or removed from inferential claims; numerical edge-case validation passes.

roadmap.objective: Execute responses and evaluators with traceable identities.
roadmap.inputs: S02 cases; S03 metrics; existing provider/SDK/API infrastructure
roadmap.deliverables: Runner/evaluator contract, response artifacts, deterministic reference evaluator, optional judge adapter and failure contracts
roadmap.exit_criteria: At least one bounded case executes from input through response to score and auditable bundle; retries/errors preserve provenance; any judge path records rubric/model/version.

roadmap.objective: Supply independent human ratings for evaluator calibration.
roadmap.inputs: S02 tasks; S03 anchored rubrics; generic review infrastructure
roadmap.deliverables: Blinded accessible rater UI, randomized assignments, rating ledger, agreement/adjudication protocol
roadmap.exit_criteria: Pilot ratings are independently attributable, assignment reproducible, calibration and disagreement reported with uncertainty; no human-as-subject claim.

roadmap.objective: Extend existing statistical machinery into prospective benchmark studies.
roadmap.inputs: S04 empirical runs; S06 ratings where needed; existing study protocols
roadmap.deliverables: Test-retest and judge studies; contamination/robustness experiments; validity dossier and negative results
roadmap.exit_criteria: Promotion evidence satisfies declared sampling/analysis criteria; uncertain results remain below M4/M5; held-out and external evidence assessed.

roadmap.objective: Rebuild HIB as a bounded participant study.
roadmap.inputs: Historical HIB intake; S05 methods; S06 interfaces
roadmap.deliverables: Versioned participant tasks, consent/accessibility/admin protocol and pilot evidence
roadmap.exit_criteria: Protocol and intended use reviewed; participant execution and data handling verified; population limits explicit; no cognitive validity inferred from completion.

roadmap.objective: Establish whether selected tasks permit fair cross-subject comparisons.
roadmap.inputs: S07 human data; S04 model runs; S05 evidence
roadmap.deliverables: Equivalence study, comparative profiles and uncertainty/exclusion report
roadmap.exit_criteria: Shared constructs and administration differences evaluated; unsupported comparisons withheld; historical HACS name resolved.

roadmap.gate: Evidence-gated benchmark expansion and community intake
roadmap.objective: Promote selected historical concepts and external contributions only when ready.
roadmap.deliverables: Small reviewed benchmark additions, ownership, conformance kit and replication records
roadmap.exit_criteria: Every added family meets declared maturity gate and maintenance/provenance requirements; no bulk import of historical prompts as validated benchmarks.

roadmap.objective: Release only the measured and supported Core surface.
roadmap.inputs: Prior dossiers, compatibility evidence and maintainer decisions
roadmap.deliverables: Compatibility/reproduction package, limitations, lifecycle support and release decision
roadmap.exit_criteria: Stable APIs/schemas and reproducibility demonstrated; maturity claims tied to evidence; unresolved validity blocks affected claims; separate publication authorization.

maturity_model.name: CONCEPT
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: Named construct and intended use; no executable benchmark claim.

maturity_model.name: SPECIFIED
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: Versioned tasks, construct, target population, rubric, metric, limitations, owner and provenance reviewed.

maturity_model.name: EXECUTABLE
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: M1 plus input-response-evaluator pipeline and error handling; tests distinguish fixtures from measured subject outputs.

maturity_model.name: REPRODUCIBLE
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: M2 plus pinned/replayable configuration, versioned inputs/evaluator, full evidence package and successful clean reproduction procedure with stated tolerances.

maturity_model.name: CALIBRATED
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: M3 plus reference annotations, evaluator calibration, variance characterization and agreement/reliability evidence appropriate to the construct.

maturity_model.name: VALIDATED
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: M4 plus construct-validity dossier, robustness/held-out studies, known limitations and human/external validation where appropriate.

maturity_model.name: CORE
maturity_model.promotion_requirements: M5 plus stable API/schema, longitudinal evidence, governance, release compatibility and maintenance commitment.
